Russian and English are mandatory production locales. Locale/runtime contracts precede native/web integration and state-preserving bilingual validation.
Language is never inferred from IP nationality SIM or store country. Locale/runtime contracts precede native/web integration and state-preserving bilingual validation.
Future third locales cannot weaken or delay complete Russian and English release. Architectural extensibility cannot advertise a third locale or weaken either required RU/EN release.
Existing site Literary Planet is sole globe foundation. Architecture/extraction defines shared ownership; later runtime/platform checks establish acceptance.
Shared IDs/coordinates/editions/textures across clients. Architecture/extraction defines shared ownership; later runtime/platform checks establish acceptance.
Canonical CMS is only factual content source. Architecture/extraction defines shared ownership; later runtime/platform checks establish acceptance.
Site/Web/PWA/Android/iOS parity gates. Architecture/extraction defines shared ownership; later runtime/platform checks establish acceptance.
Public site and admin remain regression-safe. Architecture/extraction defines shared ownership; later runtime/platform checks establish acceptance.
No remote website as native core runtime. Architecture/extraction defines shared ownership; later runtime/platform checks establish acceptance.
Safe defaults are applied without repeated clarification. Prepare validated internal artifacts first; owner approval and external actions remain separate gates.
SAFE_PAID_BILINGUAL_V1 is the default first public release profile. Prepare validated internal artifacts first; owner approval and external actions remain separate gates.
No automation accepts legal agreements, releases production or merges main. Encode the user's prohibition on automatic agreements, Submit, Release, deploy and merge; no external action is performed.
Codex reads stage-routed documents instead of full package every session. S01 installs routing controls; later checkpoint audits verify bounded document loading throughout execution.
Standalone prompt is recovery fallback and is not read twice. Recovery controls prevent repeated standalone loading; later checkpoint audits verify the rule.
Every session leaves a self-contained checkpoint with next routed docs. S01 defines persistent checkpoint semantics; later handoff checkpoints audit their continued usability.
Ready-internal, draft-ready, submitted, approved and released statuses remain distinct. Schema/state transitions must distinguish internal readiness, drafts and actual external release events.

Codex stop conditions distinguish internal failures from objective external blockers. S01 defines separate internal/external blocker semantics; checkpoints must not reclassify unfinished code or translation as owner work.
Feature flags cannot weaken safety. Implement operational controls, then verify usable runbooks and final handoff against actual artifacts.
Threat model and security tests. Boundary design and implementation precede executable security and artifact inspection gates.
No client secrets/self-grant. Boundary design and implementation precede executable security and artifact inspection gates.
